summary:
I have found the deadlock bug in `TransferService.java`, which was caused by acquiring locks on `Account` objects in parameter order. This led to a lock ordering violation when two transfers occurred in opposite directions simultaneously. 

I fixed it by enforcing a consistent lock order, ensuring the `Account` objects are always locked in the lexicographical order of their IDs regardless of which is the source and which is the destination.

Running `./test.sh` now results in:
```
PASS: All concurrent transfers completed without deadlock
```

The issue has been completely resolved.
